en.headline: Marine Department tightens harbour rules for 8pm fireworks
en.dek: A sea exclusion zone off the Convention Centre runs from 2pm to about 10pm, with a central harbour restriction from 7pm as the National Day display is fired from barges.
body: The Marine Department reminded boat operators and passengers that the National Day fireworks display is scheduled for 8pm tonight over Victoria Harbour, fired from three barges and six pontoons off the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre.

An exclusion zone around the firing barges is in force from 2pm to about 10pm. A wider restriction zone in the central harbour applies from 7pm to about 9pm; only excepted vessels and approved ferries, which may run until 7.40pm, may enter. Spectating craft may stay in designated waters outside those zones from 6pm to about 9pm.

During the designated period, skippers must keep a passenger and crew list, ensure children wear lifejackets and are accompanied by an adult, and must not speed or overload. The department said it will step up inspections and prosecute breaches. Police have said about 260,000 people are expected along both shores.

On land, public landing steps 1 to 4 at the Kowloon Public Pier close from 6pm to about 9pm, and steps 5 and 6 from 6pm until about midnight. Road closures on Hong Kong Island began from 4pm. The Observatory said a northeast monsoon would affect the eastern Guangdong coast later, with generally fine weather locally tonight.

zh.headline: 國慶煙花今晚8時 海事處設禁區並提醒海上安全
zh.dek: 會展對開海面今日下午2時至約10時設禁區，維港中部晚上7時起實施限制區；觀賞船須備乘客名單，兒童須穿救生衣。
body: 海事處提醒，今晚8時在維多利亞港舉行國慶煙花匯演，煙花由停泊於灣仔會展對開的三艘轟船及六艘浮轟燃放。
燃放範圍禁區由下午2時實施至約晚上10時。維港中部限制區由晚上7時至約9時生效，除獲許可船隻及可維持至晚上7時40分的核准渡輪外，其他船隻不得進入。觀賞船可於晚上6時至約9時在禁區及限制區以外的指明範圍停留。
在指明期間，船長須備存乘客及船員名單，確保兒童有成人陪同並全程穿上救生衣，船隻不得超速或超載。海事處表示會加強巡查，違例可被檢控。警方預計兩岸約有26萬人觀賞。
陸上方面，九龍公眾碼頭1至4號登岸梯級晚上6時至約9時封閉，5及6號則由晚上6時封閉至約午夜。港島區道路由下午4時起分階段封閉。天文台表示東北季候風晚間逐漸影響廣東東部沿岸，本港今晚大致天晴。
